# Checklist

📌 Always:

- [ ] I have set a clear title
- [ ] The title matches the complete changed-file list
- [ ] My PR is small and contains a single feature or fix workstream
- [ ] I have [checked my own PR](## "Fix typo's and remove unused or commented out code")
- [ ] I have listed the exact checks I ran and any checks I could not run

👍 Most of the time:

- [ ] I have added or updated test cases
- [ ] I have updated the README if needed
- [ ] Database entity changes include a forward-only registered migration and migration tests
- [ ] Production or deployment changes are isolated from ordinary feature work
